name: Crescent of Morningtide
description: Artifact Sygg possessed as Heir to Morningtide.

description_citations.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Holding Sygg's Crescent, Brigid meets the Source of the Wanderwine and survives the shift into Shadowmoor intact.
timeline.quote: which enabled her to survive the change between Lorwyn to Shadowmoor with her memories, abilities, and physical image intact.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen takes Ashling's elemental power, then betrays Brigid above Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Maralen snapped the Crescent from Brigid's neck and sent her falling.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen succeeded in temporarily stealing Ashling’s power for herself.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brigid takes the Crescent of Morningtide as the Great Aurora sweeps the world.
timeline.quote: unfortunately, Brigid took it as the Great Aurora swept across the world.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An ancient relic, empowered by a great elemental, that could bridge the gap between aspects without changing the bearer.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

pages_say.description: A relic that Sygg's former friends never returned.
